verdict.rationale: Windmill describes itself as an open-source developer platform. It lets developers write any integration as code in TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust and other languages, or in any Docker image, and deploy it with the documented `wmill` CLI and Git sync. That clearly covers building private integrations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a custom connector/resource-type framework or a client SDK, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on reports of building custom connectors.
